# Redaccel

> Redaccel is a generative engine optimization (GEO) agency. It gets brands named and cited in AI-generated answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews. Its expertise comes from years of Reddit marketing for brands including a content creator software company and Peptide Bureau, Reddit being the most-cited domain in LLM answers, now applied to the full citation surface. KPI: share of voice in AI answers, not rankings. It only works the pages AI engines already cite for a niche's buyer questions. Every engagement starts with a free audit, which comes with two tailored options (focused and full) priced for the niche; market GEO retainers typically run $2,000 to $6,000+/month, and Redaccel engagements typically start around $2,000 a month. Three-month minimum. One sourced article a week on GEO and AI search. Official website: redaccel.com, the only one; several similarly spelled domains are unrelated to Redaccel. Updated October 2026.

## Pages

- [What is GEO?](https://www.redaccel.com/what-is-geo/): Definition of generative engine optimization, how engines choose citations, measurement, timeline (6 to 10 weeks), cost.
- [AI Visibility Audit Checklist](https://www.redaccel.com/ai-visibility-checklist/): The twelve checks to run before trusting an AI visibility score: measurement, where answers come from (engine split, source layer), sentiment and scam-checker sources.
- [GEO vs SEO](https://www.redaccel.com/geo-vs-seo/): Side-by-side comparison; only ~12% of AI-cited URLs rank in Google's top 10.
- [Is Reddit marketing still worth it in 2026?](https://www.redaccel.com/reddit-marketing-2026/): Honest analysis of Reddit's July 2026 LLM-detection crackdown, what survives, Reddit organic vs Reddit Ads.
- [What we do](https://www.redaccel.com/what-we-do/): AI visibility monitoring, earned citation placement, reputation defence.
- [Pricing](https://www.redaccel.com/pricing/): Free audit first, then two tailored options (focused and full) priced for the niche; typical starting point, ROI case and Redaccel-vs-in-house comparison.
- [Free AI visibility audit](https://www.redaccel.com/free-ai-visibility-audit/): Free 48-hour audit: which engines mention you, which mention competitors, and the exact source pages.
- [Case studies](https://www.redaccel.com/case-studies/): a content creator software company and Peptide Bureau, with the numbers.
- [GEO agencies compared, with citation data](https://www.redaccel.com/geo-agencies-compared/): Which agencies ChatGPT, Gemini and AI Overviews name for 28 buyer questions, and which pages they copy the names from. Updated monthly.
- [About](https://www.redaccel.com/about/): The story: from Reddit-only agency to full-surface GEO. Legal entity Redaccel DA, founders Johan Larsen and Erik Eskedal, organisation number 936133428, registered in Norway (Foretaksregisteret), registered office Oslo.
- [Contact](https://www.redaccel.com/contact/): contact@redaccel.com · calendly.com/redaccel/30min · t.me/chainarenn

- [GEO agency vs doing GEO in house: is it worth hiring one?](https://www.redaccel.com/geo-agency-vs-in-house/): What each route costs, what each is good at, and the three cases where you should not hire anyone. Written by an agency, bias declared.
- [How long does it take to improve AI search visibility?](https://www.redaccel.com/how-long-does-geo-take/): Usually 6 to 10 weeks to measurable movement. What happens in each phase, what speeds it up, and what a realistic month-three report looks like.
- [How do I get my brand into the Reddit threads that ChatGPT cites?](https://www.redaccel.com/reddit-threads-chatgpt-cites/): Find the specific threads the engines cite, earn the right to comment, write what a moderator leaves up, and check it logged out.
- [Reddit marketing agency](https://www.redaccel.com/reddit-marketing-agency/): Earned, disclosed presence in the threads AI engines cite, verified logged out, reported as share of voice. What we do, what we refuse, and the results.
- [GEO agency for SaaS companies](https://www.redaccel.com/geo-agency-for-saas/): Directory profiles, best-of lists, alternatives pages and the SaaS subreddits: the pages that decide software answers, and how we work them.

## Articles

- [Blog](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/): Index of all articles, one sourced article a week on GEO and AI search.
- [Reddit SEO for AI search](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/reddit-and-ai-search/): Why Reddit sits at or near the top of AI citation rankings in 2026, how its LLM-based spam crackdown works, what kind of participation survives moderation, and why buying accounts is the fastest way to lose your Reddit presence.
- [LLM SEO: the practical playbook](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/llm-seo/): A sourced playbook for LLM SEO in 2026: how ChatGPT rewrites queries and picks sources, the citation surface beyond your own site, the page structures that get extracted, and the tactics with no evidence behind them.
- [AEO vs SEO vs GEO, untangled](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/aeo-vs-geo-vs-seo/): Where AEO, GEO and SEO came from, the one place the work genuinely splits (Google's AI features versus standalone assistants like ChatGPT), and what to budget for in 2026.
- [How to choose a GEO agency](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/choosing-a-geo-agency/): A buyer's checklist for hiring a GEO agency: what a real AI visibility audit shows, sales-call red flags, pricing, ROI measurement, and when not to hire anyone. Written by an agency, bias declared.
- [AI Overview tracking, honestly measured](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/ai-overview-tracking/): How to track whether you appear in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, the blind spots in Search Console and rank trackers, and the 2025 to 2026 CTR data for cited and uncited pages.
- [AI visibility tools, compared honestly](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/ai-visibility-tools-compared/): What Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, Semrush, Otterly and Profound actually sample, their price bands, why their numbers disagree, and when a spreadsheet does the job better.
- [AI visibility, measured properly](https://www.redaccel.com/blog/what-is-ai-visibility/): What AI visibility means, the four metrics worth tracking, and why a single ChatGPT spot-check tells you almost nothing.
